headline: Quavo brought “HAAVIN” & “Hit-A-Lik” to life on Amazon Music’s In The Paint Huncho perform
body: Quavo brought “HAAVIN” & “Hit-A-Lik” to life on Amazon Music’s In The Paint Huncho performed both tracks from his new album “QRÖMELIFE,” bringing his latest music to the court. The “HAAVIN” performance aired during NBA Night Cap on Prime Video, while the “Hit-A-Lik” performance video is available exclusively on Quavo’s profile in the Amazon Music app Which track are you running back first—“HAAVIN” or “Hit-A-Lik”? Allegations are not findings of guilt.
